charts.title: K2-416 b: orbits around K2-416
charts.description: The orbits of K2-416's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-416 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Incha et al. 2023 (2023MNRAS.523..474I), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname INCHA_ET_AL__2023): P 13.102 d
